objective: GRPO with PPO clipping: maximise the mean over informative groups of the mean over that group's answers of (1/|o|) sum_t [min(rho_t A, clip(rho_t, 1-e, 1+e) A) - beta k3(pi_theta, pi_ref)] for several epochs, with rho_t = pi_theta / pi_old using fixed old log-probabilities, A = (r - mean(r)) / (std(r) + 1e-4) over the group, and k3 = pi_ref/pi_theta - log(pi_ref/pi_theta) - 1
reference: frozen initial policy: the same NF4 weights with the LoRA adapter disabled
old_policy: log-probabilities fixed before the first epoch
optimizer: AdamW, betas 0.9 and 0.99, no weight decay, gradient norm clipped to 1.0, one step per epoch
sampling: trap reasons rotate evenly; a group whose first answers all score the same gets more answers, and so does a trap group without a correct answer; only groups with different rewards are trained on
group_weighting: every informative group carries the same weight, shared equally by its answers
